On-line, modular

Genset power is selected taking into account motor inrush currents, the operating mode (standby or prime), the site altitude above sea level and the air temperature, at which a diesel engine loses power. If the generator feeds a UPS, its rating is taken at least one and a half times higher than the UPS power. A voltage stabiliser is selected by apparent power with a 30 % margin and a correction for the depth of input voltage sags: at 150 V instead of 220 V the stabiliser's output power drops, and the rating has to be increased. Electromechanical models are chosen for machine tools and compressors, electronic ones for electronics and medical equipment. An AEC engineer checks any calculation from the calculator free of charge and sends a specification with prices and lead times.
